sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports for the reset button
sections.what: Brings in the tools the button needs: state handling, page navigation, and the translated text.
sections.why: Lets the button remember its status, move the user after a reset, and show text in the right language.
sections.watch_out: Nothing here runs by itself, so a missing import would stop the whole button from working.

sections.name: DemoResetButton
sections.title: Reset action and button
sections.what: When clicked, asks the server to reset the chosen demo case. On success, opens that case. On failure, shows an error message and re-enables the button. While running, the button is disabled and shows a loading label.
sections.why: Gives a single clear action for resetting the demo, with feedback while it runs and when it fails.
sections.watch_out: The button stays disabled while a reset runs, so a request that never returns would leave it stuck until the page is reloaded.

summary: A button that resets a demo case to its starting data and then opens that case.
purpose: Lets someone testing the demo put a demo family back to its original state with one click.
why: Likely reason: demo data gets changed while people explore it, so a reset gives a clean start. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Imports the translated text and router. Keeps two pieces of state, one for the status message and one for whether a reset is running. On click, sends a POST request to the reset endpoint with the case ID. If the response is fine, opens the case page. If not, shows an error message and turns the button back on.
inputs: An optional case ID, with a default of the first demo family. Only two demo IDs are allowed by the type.
outputs: A button, plus an optional status message shown below it when a reset fails.
risks: Resetting changes stored data for the chosen demo case. It is only meant for demo cases. A failed reset shows only a generic message.
debug: If the button does nothing, check the browser network log for the reset request and its response code. If the message never clears, check the state updates after a failed request.
